title: Chapter 6672: Astral Form

Chapter 6672: Astral Form

Chapter 6672: Astral Form

Three Immortals once had six redemption grounds. However, three lost and one fell during Heavenslay, leaving behind two - Evil Transformation and Fiendish Ground.

“Boom!” Once the pillars reached the limit, the two immortals finally showed up.

All affinities and worldly essences flowed toward them. They were the primordial so everything else wanted to follow, surging toward them like tsunamis.

This also applied to the dao powers of cultivators. Everything wanted to be one with the primordial.

However, the two had the purest primordial energy and didn’t need to absorb the influx. They sent them back to the sources. The tsunamis suffered a violent push and flowed backward.

Cultivators heaved a sigh of relief upon seeing this.

“Who can resist the temptation?” Weizhen and Supreme Black Ancestor murmured.

As overlords, they needed to initiate the absorption process. Immortals had an easier time. For example, Bao Pu could have done so in a short period.

These two primordial immortals, on the other hand, didn’t need to do anything. Delicious food came knocking on their door.

When the crowd calmed down, they saw the two immortals standing before Li Qiye. They had an automatic primordial aura pulsing across the world. Everything else paled in comparison.

These two beings didn’t have a physical form, but rather seemed to be made from the endless space.

One had the form of an abyss with countless stars trapped within. The other’s astral form changed continuously, ranging from a phoenix to a radiant dao heart...

The overlords who had seen them found this shocking. They didn’t use to look like this.

“Long time no see, Fellow Daoist.” Evil Transformation spoke. An immortal radiance oozed out from the source of the voice.

“We didn’t expect to see you again, Fellow Daoist.” Fiendish Ground spoke. Something about this abyss frightened others since they felt like prey at any moment.

“Taking your roots out too?” Li Qiye said.

“We must try our best after all.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Still don’t need to take this form.” Li Qiye said.

“We are prepared to die.” Evil Transformation added.

“Preparing for the villainous heaven, I see. This is more than just losing lifespan, it’s destruction.” Li Qiye said.

“That is true.” The two exchanged glances.

They hid in their redemption grounds for a reason. The price to leave was immense.

“So determined, ready to fight to the death, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“You wouldn’t let us go, Fellow Daoist.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Hmm...” Li Qiye stroked his chin and replied: “Is this astral form of yours that different from death?”
